tasks.title: Probe preserves startup coverage with eight process tests within the CPU limit
tasks.spec: ## Repository: probe, all change bullets, Checks and Completion evidence; Performance impact; Security impact; Counterexamples (probe removal and no test.skip); Acceptance evidence 1. Delete the 14 specified duplicate spawn cases and preserve the eight specified process tests. Add the in-process EISDIR case through startupMessage. Add the explicit stdout tok-secret absence assertion to the retained PULSE_API_URL test, retaining its stderr assertion. Keep the invalid UTF-8 token-file process test and its real readFileSync path and both-stream redaction checks. Map each removed test to its in-process twin. No production, budget, dependency, CI or coverage changes.

acceptance.expected: 8 pass, 0 fail, 0 skip; eight children, one per remaining test: bad PULSE_API_URL, occupied health port, SIGTERM, healthz/metrics/shutdown, token-file success, ENOENT, invalid UTF-8 token content, and private-ranges end-to-end. The bad-setting test asserts exit 2, one error line naming PULSE_API_URL and no tok-secret in stdout or stderr. The invalid UTF-8 test keeps exit 2, one sanitized error line and no SENTINEL in either stream. A focused run may exit nonzero because of the full-suite coverage threshold; accept the test results here.

0 fail, 0 skip; the added failingReader(new FakeFsError(message containing SENTINEL, EISDIR)) case with PULSE_PROBE_TOKEN_FILE=/dir gives exactly PULSE_PROBE_TOKEN_FILE=/dir: cannot read (EISDIR) through startupMessage, with no SENTINEL. All existing token cases pass. A focused run may exit nonzero because of the full-suite coverage threshold.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and full tests pass with 0 fail, 0 skip and line coverage at least 80 %.

acceptance.command: git rev-parse HEAD && bun --version && lscpu && for sample in 1 2 3 4 5; do bun -e 'const p = Bun.spawn(["bun", "run", "test"], { stdout: "ignore", stderr: "ignore" }); const code = await p.exited; const u = p.resourceUsage(); console.log(code, ((Number(u.cpuTime.user) + Number(u.cpuTime.system)) / 1e6).toFixed(2))'; done
acceptance.expected: Run on clean main 8260148 (or current main) and on branch head, on the same EPYC 7763-class runner with Bun 1.4.0. Record both SHAs, CPU model, Bun version and 5 samples per side, all with test exit code 0. The branch median (3rd smallest of 5) must be at most 2.20 s. Above 2.20 s, request needs-input with the samples instead of cutting more tests or raising a budget.

acceptance.command: git diff --check && git diff --name-only <base-sha> HEAD && git diff <base-sha> HEAD -- src/main.test.ts src/token.test.ts
acceptance.expected: exit 0; only src/main.test.ts and src/token.test.ts change. Exactly 14 specified duplicate process tests are deleted, no test.skip is introduced, and the EISDIR in-process case and bad-setting stdout assertion are added. The six specified single process tests and the two retained loop entries keep all prior assertions. Removed assertions remain covered by the in-process twins named in the spec. Security review confirms token content is absent from both output streams; production, dependencies, Dockerfiles, CI, budgets and coverage settings are unchanged.

acceptance.command: gh pr checks <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-probe && gh pr view <pr-number> --repo lorenzh/pulse-probe --json body --jq .body
acceptance.expected: Required CI checks pass, including shared lint/typecheck/test and Docker. The PR names #585, lists the eight retained spawns and every deleted test with its in-process twin (file:line), gives both SHAs, CPU model, Bun version, 5 CPU samples and median per side, branch median at most 2.20 s, coverage at least 80 %, checks/results and known limits.
